research_question: Do the unchanged CPQR and full-rank SVD endpoint corrections generalize from the representative T0 screen to the frozen 48-case, eight-family development corpus without safety, recall, or callback-work regression?

corpus.case_validation: ordered instance ID, family ID, replay checksum, target count, Gold-target artifact checksum, Gold-configuration checksum, saved-start artifact checksum and saved-start shape must all equal the committed manifest

execution.stop_policy: stop each case/variant after the first completed attempt with cumulative callbacks >=4800 or after 32 starts
execution.host_parallelism: at most 16 case processes pinned across CPU0-15; rotate case assignment across batches
execution.primary_work: sum of per-case earliest suffix-stable common-assessor safe-full callbacks; miss or value above 4800 is right-censored to 4800

promotion_gate_per_candidate.active_family_definition: at least one paired candidate endpoint differs from its shadow and either drops an unsafe shadow endpoint or remains common-assessor qualified, Gold-consistent, unambiguous, and matched to the same target as the shadow
promotion_gate_per_candidate.cpqr_svd_disagreement: report every endpoint class, safety, target, and work disagreement; never use disagreement for per-case routing

finalist_tie_break_if_both_pass: on an exact remaining tie choose CPQR
passing_scope: T2 passage authorizes only representation-replica and U2/U3/U4 holdout evaluation of one fixed finalist; it does not authorize Core integration, production promotion, or a case-specific portfolio.
